name: 阮一峰的网络日志
description: A classic must-watch, updated weekly. Whether it's watching news, studying, or broadening horizons, there's joy to be found in all these activities. There are also weekly comments from netizens. This is the value of a blog.

name: Enji Kusnadi
description: The first person who amazed me in terms of design was someone I mentioned often when recommending other blogs. However, this does not count as her blog website, only her online resume, with no continuous content, which is quite a pity.

name: Josh W. Comeau
description: John’s blog resembles a course website, with each article written exceptionally well, allowing readers to gain new insights with every read. The website design is also perfectly balanced—neat and engaging.

name: nanda
description: Design Master, Nanda. The pages use only gray with lines, which makes me feel truly impressed. There isn't much content, but each piece is meticulously crafted. Like Josh, it belongs to a technical website, but its tutorial guidance is even more exceptional, making it a true programmer artist.

name: Emil Kowalski
description: The blog simply has "no design" and no decorations. The technology side is a bit easier, as it emphasizes animations/interactions. As a Vercel employee, his components are very useful and truly vercel-like.

name: Risingle
description: The website design is excellent. Although it uses someone else's template, it is well done. It's a programmer just starting out.

name: 無名小栈
description: The template owner of Risingle blog might not match the profile picture and website style, making it feel less comfortable than Risingle. There are many popular projects on Github, clearly indicating someone who loves to experiment, but they don’t like writing blogs, so there’s little content. In 2001, quite young, independent developer? I don’t know what experiences they have had.

name: 韩小韩博客
description: The website is great, with plenty of content and a cool profile picture. I wonder if the person is attractive. It's this misaligned sliding effect that keeps bothering me, and the damping effect has really improved in terms of blog professionalism... Regarding the import of a plugin, it would be great if he could remove this effect soon. I'd like to check out more of his content, but the effect is too confusing.

name: Anthony Fu
description: A really impressive person, still seems quite young. He is often active on b站 and streams live (I've watched). I remember he did many remarkable things shortly after graduating, a core member of the vue series, which seems like something he handles easily. Most of his blog posts are in English, and his social circle is filled with experts, which is great. I don't write blogs much, but still, it's considered good compared to others. We can glimpse some aspects of the "upper class" in vue through him.

name: enpitsulin 铅笔
description: A very simple blog website, like Nanda. It's just that there hasn't been any content for a long time. My memory is fuzzy about his current profile picture, but suddenly I remember his cute profile picture from before, and I think of this person now.

name: Innei 静かな森
description: The website is decent, a typical product of a certain era that I don’t fully understand. However, the content is active, and it seems quite popular? But I haven’t figured out why it’s so popular. There are quite a few projects.

name: 秋夜灯雨
description: From the name, it’s clear he’s one of the remnants from the past. However, I really like his design—the pages are clear and have a scholarly atmosphere. Although he’s an elder, there isn’t much history he can trace.

name: BlogFinder
description: A blog collection website that allows you to view which blogs exist and directly check who has updated recently

name: Tonsky
description: A former international expert who hasn't been found since, but their blog still gets updated from time to time. It's just that now the blog is too eye-catching, not sure if it's intentional.

name: Cali
description: Designer, the website looks great, but the blog content is limited. What's impressive is that he has started his own company, designing websites for others; Yingshi and Insta360 were also designed by him. It's a good reference for the blog. His zolplay website has a similar style to Nanda's, it's unclear who copied it from.

name: Chrome Blog
description: A tech team blog with consultations, updates, and stories. I think the page feels pretty good.

name: Huozhi
description: Minimalists, the website is truly minimalist, but it doesn’t feel bad either. There’s not much content, but if you feel stuck on how to design a blog or if it’s not well-designed, look at it.

name: Brian Lovin
description: Early foreign experts worked at Github and Facebook, and now at Notion, with extensive experience and multiple projects. The blog has been transformed into a Dashboard-style format, which is quite unique, but there aren't many blogs.

name: Cassie Evans's Blog
description: Colorful websites are really cool. And it's a woman, which is quite rare. GASP, SVG, and animations are beautifully designed, but there aren't many articles, which is also a curse of advanced blogs. She's also a celebrity on Twitter.

name: Niracler 的博物志
description: Little transparent, occasionally updates a blog. However, the website style has its own characteristics that can serve as a reference for designing blogs.

name: 講評世界
description: Little transparent, missing persons. But the blog website style has a kind of typographic beauty, I don't know how to describe it. It seems to be a member of Film Hurricane.

name: 阿猫的博客
description: A cute website that keeps updating its Cat Fish Weekly.

name: pseudoyu
description: A blockchain developer spent some time working on Monad blockchain. The website looks exactly like Anthony’s. He keeps mentioning his senior’s wife. Should be quite impressive too.

name: 季节记忆
description: Looks like it's for backend/embedded? A blog established at the beginning of 2025 with no UI design. However, few backend developers use blogs, so it should be encouraged.

name: 微尔微
description: A new wandering monk in 23 years, as he says, spends a day working on some strange things. It should focus on the backend, and he likes to complete some hardware. It's a Jingsen-related blog, with stable output since 25.

name: 搬砖日记
description: White background with black text. However, it is well-maintained. It should be an Android developer who has been sharing various explorations since 2024. The origin is unclear.

name: 博客.cn
description: It seems to be a internal blog on Notion for XMind, not confirmed yet, but the content inside is indeed professional and insightful, so I’ll save it for now

name: KK
description: kk is a really impressive person. Suddenly thinking of him from my social media, I realized he had a blog, although it's no longer maintained. But there are still some good elements in his blog that might be useful to you.

name: 猫普的精神世界
description: Another open-source project discovered through issue, which was also open-sourced these days – quite coincidental. The liquid glass-like design gives a similar feel, which is quite good, though there are some flaws. I still really like it. The content starts from 25.

name: 手里有只毛毛虫
description: The website is very comfortable to use, developed independently by a hexagonal warrior. The article categories make it easy to browse at a glance, while finding specific content is a bit more challenging.

name: Honesty
description: Trouvinging the backend of the blog is an excellent example for learning backend skills; it has been a focus for many years. The website is quite good, but the loading of content is a bit slow.

name: ElysiumStack
description: A UI designer blogger is rare, and their blog designs are excellent. A sense of gaming is present, starting from 25 years ago.

name: 十玖八柒
description: In 4D dimension, backend development, many backend research papers have been written. However, work on frontend and blogs is still extensive. Maintaining a blog with a unique and comfortable style is truly rare.

name: 纸鹿摸鱼处
description: The popular open-source blog owner, today bumped into his group members, 🤣, giving him an extra point 🤣🤣🤣.

name: 灯火不休时
description: Group members, JAVAR, clean blog, let me see the shadows of a few people.
